run_simulation: run a Concordia simulation with a config, model, and embedder using the sequential engine
extract_dialog: extract a formatted dialog transcript from a Concordia simulation log object
get_prefabs: load all available Concordia entity and game master prefabs into a dictionary
run_simulation_with_callbacks: run a Concordia simulation with step callbacks and entity info callbacks for serve mode
run_simulation_with_model_overrides: run a Concordia simulation with separate model overrides for agents and game masters
